home.title: Independent blogs, in any language.
home.intro: Blogs and personal websites with a feed, claimed by their authors. Subscribe in one click; Tela translates as you read.

login.title: Sign in to Tela
login.intro: A code by email. No passwords.
login.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. Enter it here, or open the link in the same email.
login.connecting: You are signed in. Connecting to Tela…

errors.invalid_email: That does not look like an email address.
errors.not_configured: Sign-in is not configured on this server.
errors.send_failed: We could not send the code. Try again in a minute.
errors.bad_code: That code is wrong or has expired.
errors.link_failed: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new code.
errors.not_invited: Tela is in private testing. This address does not have an account yet.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.

list.emptyHint: Add a feed to start reading.
list.fetching: Fetching this feed for the first time…
list.allReadHint: Read posts are hidden. <settings>Show them again</settings> in Settings.

reader.articleGone: That article is no longer here. Pick another on the left.
reader.recommendHint: Shown on your profile and to the author.

add.none: No feed found at that address.
add.opmlHint: Exported from another reader. Up to 500 feeds.
add.imported: Imported {n, plural, one {# feed} other {# feeds}}.

discover.title: Independent blogs, in any language.
discover.intro: Blogs and personal websites with a feed, claimed by their authors. Subscribe in one click; Tela translates as you read.

discover.empty: No blogs listed here yet. Claim yours to be the first.

claim.title: Have a blog?
claim.intro: Claim your feed to see who reads you, which posts they liked, and what they said when recommending them.

claim.title: Claim your feed
claim.intro: Tell us your blog's address. We will find its feed, then ask you to prove you control the site.
claim.verifyIntro: Add one of the two snippets to the home page of {site}:
claim.optionMetaHint: Put this in the <head> of your home page. You can remove it after verification.
claim.optionRelMeHint: Link to your Tela profile from your home page (a link in the footer works).
claim.verified: Verified. This site is yours on Tela.
claim.verifiedHint: It is now listed in Discover. Pick its topics on the site page, and see readers and likes in your dashboard.
claim.claimedByOther: This site has already been claimed by another Tela member.

errors.invalid_url: That does not look like a URL.
errors.no_feed: No feed found at that address. Tela lists sites that publish a feed.

following.title: Following
following.intro: What the people you follow are reading, liking and passing on.
following.liked: {n, plural, one {liked a post} other {liked # posts}}
following.subscribed: {n, plural, one {subscribed to} other {subscribed to # blogs, including}}

following.failed: The activity could not be loaded.
following.noOneYet: No one yet. Follow readers from their profiles.

dashboard.title: Your sites
dashboard.intro: Who reads you, which posts they liked, and what they said when recommending them.
dashboard.noSites: You have not claimed a site yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.profileIntro: How you appear to readers and authors on Tela.
settings.pictureFallbackGravatar: Shown everywhere. Remove it to go back to your Gravatar.
settings.pictureFallbackInitial: Shown everywhere. Remove it to go back to your initial.

gravatarHints.shown: From the email you sign in with, wherever your name appears; others see a change within minutes. Changed it on Gravatar? Refresh.
gravatarHints.none: Gravatar has no picture for the email you sign in with, so your initial is shown.
gravatarHints.checking: Asking Gravatar about the email you sign in with…
gravatarHints.off: Off: your initial is shown unless you upload a picture.

pictureErrors.unreadable: That file is not a picture this browser can read.
pictureErrors.rate_limited: Too many changes in an hour. Try again later.
pictureErrors.failed: The picture could not be saved. Try again.

settings.cropHint: Drag to move it, and zoom to frame it.
settings.cropArea: The picture, in the circle it is shown in. The arrow keys move it.
settings.name: Name
settings.handleHint: 3–30 lowercase letters, digits, or underscores. Used in your profile URL.
settings.charsLeft: {n, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} left

errors.invalid_handle: Handles are 3–30 lowercase letters, digits, or underscores, and some words are reserved.

settings.readingIntro: How articles look and behave in Reading.
settings.measureHint: How wide an article's column may grow.
settings.markOnOpenHint: Otherwise, a post stays unread until you mark it.
settings.hideReadHint: Lists show unread posts only. Liked posts are always kept.
settings.translationIntro: The language Tela itself speaks, and the one it translates posts into. The original is always one click away.
settings.uiLocaleHint: Menus, buttons and messages, on every device you sign in on.
settings.autoTranslateHint: If off, foreign posts open in the original with a Translate button.
settings.neverHint: Languages you read comfortably: their posts open in the original, titles included.
settings.subscriptionsIntro: {n, plural, one {# blog} other {# blogs}}. Bring feeds from another reader with OPML.
settings.privacyIntro: Choose what others see on your profile.
settings.showLikesHint: On your profile, and to people who follow you. Authors see how many likes a post has, never who liked it.
settings.showSubscriptionsHint: List the blogs you read on your profile.
settings.privacyDelay: Your public profile can take a few minutes to catch up with a change.
settings.yourDataHint: Your profile, subscriptions, likes, recommendations, highlights and the people you follow, as one file.
